name: InniClassic 20261105
body:
> **Final InniClassic release.** Development continues as **Classy** at [ClassyPlayer/Classy](https://github.com/ClassyPlayer/Classy). This fork is kept as the OTA endpoint for devices running the InniClassic builds, and as an archive of the last release published under that name.
>
> Mirror of [20261105 on ClassyPlayer/Classy](https://github.com/ClassyPlayer/Classy/releases/tag/20261105). Only the launcher APK and the OTA metadata are copied here; the flashable ROMs (~2.1 GB) stay on the Classy repository.

### InniClassic Release

Automated build with full support for **Innioasis Y1** (Type A & Type B) and **Innioasis Y2**.

#### 📦 Release Assets

| File | Target Device | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`InniClassic-20261105.apk`** | All Devices (Y1 / Y2) | Standalone launcher APK (sideload or install) |
| **`update.json`** | All Devices | OTA update metadata for in-app updater |
| **`SHA256SUMS.txt`** | All Files | SHA-256 integrity checksums |

The flashable ROMs are **not** mirrored here — download them from [ClassyPlayer/Classy 20261105](https://github.com/ClassyPlayer/Classy/releases/tag/20261105):

| File | Target Device | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`rom_y2.zip`** | **Innioasis Y2** (MT6582) | Complete flashable ROM with dual-storage, watchdog & clickwheel keylayout |
| **`rom_y1_type_a.zip`** (`rom.zip`) | **Innioasis Y1** (Type A) | Flashable ROM for Y1 players with original firmware **2.0.0 or higher** |
| **`rom_y1_type_b.zip`** (`rom_type_b.zip`) | **Innioasis Y1** (Type B) | Flashable ROM for Y1 players with original firmware **below 2.0.0** |

#### ⚡ Flashing Instructions (SP Flash Tool)
1. Extract the corresponding zip file for your device.
2. Launch `flash_tool.exe` (or Linux `flash_tool`).
3. Load the scatter file (`MT6582_Android_scatter.txt` for Y2, `MT6572_Android_scatter.txt` for Y1).
4. Select **Firmware Upgrade** or **Download Only**.
5. Power off the device completely, click **Download**, and connect the USB cable.

---


## What's Changed
* fix(battery): show the battery level from the voltage on the Y2, warn at 10 % and 3 %, and shut down before the cut-off by @ferrolho in https://github.com/ClassyPlayer/Classy/pull/41
* feat(navigation): navigate like the iPod: one back stack, menu slides, and list screens in place of dialogs by @ferrolho in https://github.com/ClassyPlayer/Classy/pull/42
* refactor(ui): remove the App Drawer and Screen Recorder screens, which nothing can open by @ferrolho in https://github.com/ClassyPlayer/Classy/pull/44


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ClassyPlayer/Classy/compare/20261104...20261105
